main.description: Public lookup of one indexed activity by full AT-URI. Authentication is not required.

uri.description: Full AT-URI of the activity record, using a DID authority.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is not a full activity AT-URI or the request contains an unsupported parameter.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed activity exists at this AT-URI.

errors.name: ActivityQueryFailed
errors.description: The activity or required hydration lookup failed; retry after checking the HappyView PostgreSQL service.

activityView.description: Activity record with metadata, unchanged source payload, hydrated author, and optional contributor projection.

contributors.description: Hydrated contributor projection in the same order and with the same multiplicity as record.contributors; omitted only when the source field is absent.

activityContributorView.description: Original activity contributor fields with exact-version contributor information and nullable actor hydration.

contributorInformationView.description: The exact indexed contributor-information version identified by the source strong reference.

contributorActorView.description: Contributor DID with nullable current Certified profile.
